title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) — “We’re discontinuing the Apple AirPort base station products”
text:
April 26, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) — “We’re discontinuing the Apple AirPort base station products”
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) just announced the end of production on its AirPort line of base stations, it’s an end of an era in Cupertino today, as it is shutting a list that includes the AirPort Extreme, AirPort Express, and AirPort Time Capsule.
The Cupertino company noted that it will continue to sell its remaining stock, in a statement provided to TechCrunch, but once it’s done, it’s done. “We’re discontinuing the Apple AirPort base station products,” says the spokesperson. “They will be available through Apple.com, Apple’s retail stores and Apple Authorized Resellers while supplies last.”
The end of the line probably doesn’t come as too much of a surprise for outsiders. A lot has changed in the home networking category since Apple arrived on the scene nearly 20 years back. A number of other consumer electronics bigwigs have entered the fray, along with a number of notable startups.
